uutiset.t: Rooney says he considered taking his own life at Man Utd
uutiset.s: Wayne Rooney says he considered taking his own life during his playing days at Manchester United and was "speaking to a therapist to try and figure out what was up".

uutiset.t: DeChambeau joins DP World Tour after LIV Golf collapse
uutiset.s: American superstar Bryson DeChambeau is among a number of former LIV players who will play on the European-based DP World Tour next season.

uutiset.t: Chargers earn first victory of the season against the Ravens
uutiset.s: The Los Angeles Chargers hold on to win their first game of the season, beating the Baltimore Ravens 23-20.

uutiset.t: England stars to help launch Moody MND challenge at All Blacks match
uutiset.s: Lewis Moody says he has been buoyed by the current England team's support as he launches his latest challenge in aid of Motor Neurone Disease (MND) research.

uutiset.t: Bethell to have more surgery and miss South Africa tour
uutiset.s: Jacob Bethell will miss England’s Test tour of South Africa because he requires more surgery on the knee injury that has kept him out since July.

uutiset.t: Romario demands Ancelotti sacking as war of words continues
uutiset.s: Romario, Brazil's fourth-highest scorer behind only Neymar, Pele and Ronaldo publicly demands that legendary manager Ancelotti be relieved of his duties.

uutiset.t: Hincapie in advanced talks over new Arsenal deal
uutiset.s: Arsenal are in advanced talks with defender Piero Hincapie over a new contract.

uutiset.t: Swansea boss Matos close to Strasbourg move
uutiset.s: Vitor Matos is understood to have indicated he is interested in leaving Swansea, who have had an official approach from the French top-flight club.

uutiset.t: Man convicted for racist abuse of Real Madrid's Mbappe
uutiset.s: A man has been convicted of a hate crime after directing racist insults at Real Madrid forward Kylian Mbappe during a La Liga match at Real Oviedo in 2025.

uutiset.t: Watch: Can Northern Ireland hit the right notes in Budapest?
uutiset.s: As Northern Ireland prepare to face Hungary in a key Nations League encounter, BBC Sport NI teams up with the Ulster Orchestra to build up to the big game in Budapest in musical fashion.

uutiset.t: Coach given one-game ban for head push on female player
uutiset.s: University basketball coach Bill Fennelly is given a one-game suspension for pushing a female player on the head during a timeout.

uutiset.t: 'Why not have a go?' - the halfway line goal phenomenon
uutiset.s: Why Premier League players are trying their luck on goal from long range more regularly.

uutiset.t: Triple Scotland injury blow for Japan finale
uutiset.s: Captain Sione Tuipulotu, scrum-half Ben White and number eight Jack Dempsey are ruled out of Scotland's final Nations Championship group game at home to Japan on Saturday.

uutiset.t: GB's Patten criticises ATP chairman and CEO for absence
uutiset.s: Britain's top-ranked doubles player Henry Patten criticises the ATP's chairman and CEO for missing the year-end world number one trophy presentation.

uutiset.t: Prison sentences rescinded after Nurmagomedov-Dvalishvili brawl
uutiset.s: The eight people who received prison sentences for their part in a mass brawl involving MMA fighters Usman Nurmagomedov and Merab Dvalishvili have been released.
